entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 4688810475608636800 (Gaia Collaboration 2023, A&A 674, A1), ICRS at epoch J2016.0, from the archived row src/objects/hv-1328/source/photometry/gaia-dr3-source.csv. Distance: Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, HV 1328: Baade-Wesselink distance (pc) 55005.4 +/- 4054.3 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 55005.4 +/- 4054.3 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 0.0036 +/- 0.0148 mas (same row, RUWE 1.11), 0.2 standard errors, is not used. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): 0.589, -1.208 mas/yr. Radial velocity: Gaia DR3 (same row): 118.91 +/- 5.23 km/s.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 77.2 +/- 5.8 solar radii from Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, HV 1328: Baade-Wesselink mean radius (solar radii) 77.2 +/- 5.8 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 53,708,040 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 5750 +/- 125 K from Groenewegen & Lub (2023), A&A 676, A136, VizieR J/A+A/676/A136/table1, Name=SMC0152, columns Teffp, e_Teffp: Teff 5750 +/- 125 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic) (https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.07559). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.

entries.subject: Light curve
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 vari_cepheid, source 4688810475608636800: 4 G-band harmonics of a 15.83749319141228 d period, peak-to-peak 0.681 mag; the harmonics reproduce the row's epoch of maximum and peak-to-peak amplitude. The page plays it as a veil over the disc from the scene date, phase known to 0.01 of a cycle there.

entries.subject: Colour
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 5,750 K, because interstellar dust reddens every spectrum of this star, E(B-V) = 0.004 +/- 0.003 (Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10), and its light changes through each pulsation, through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #fff0e9. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: skipped; gaia-xp: skipped; pulkovo: skipped; kiehling: skipped; kharitonov: skipped; burnashev: skipped; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 5,750 K and log g 2.38 (u1 0.448, u2 0.260): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.

entries.subject: Surface gravity
entries.finding: Published: log g 2.38 from 2021MNRAS.506..150B (GALAH DR3, a survey pipeline: no analysis of this star's own spectra is published); the 2 published values span log g 1.9191 to 2.3848, across which the limb law changes by at most 0.4% of the centre brightness.
